metadata.question: Did nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine, decrease in May 2022 compared to March 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (VNP46A2 or DNB_MONTHLY_V1) – I will use the monthly DNB composites from the NASA “Black Marble” collection C1: “NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG”. 2. Dates: March and May 2022 (exactly “2022-03-01” and “2022-05-01”). 3. Location: Obolon, Ukraine (place name ≈ 50.51°N, 30.49°E). Build a small 1 km Point/Buffer geometry. 4. Masking: Nighttime lights product has no clouds over land in monthly composites; no masking needed. 5. Logic: average radiance for each month; if May average < March average → decrease → “A”, else “B”. If any month has no images (impossible here in monthly composites) → C1. If valid pixel count = 0 → C2. If any mean is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time geom = ee.Geometry.Point([30.49, 50.51]).buffer(1000) # Obolon ~1 km radius mar = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG").filter(ee.Filter.date("2022-03-01", "2022-04-01")) may = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG").filter(ee.Filter.date("2022-05-01", "2022-06-01")) # 2. Check availability if mar.size().getInfo() == 0 or may.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: Empty collection.") print("C1") # 3. Extract mean radiance meanMar = mar.first().select("avg_rad").reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) meanMay = may.first().select("avg_rad").reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) valMar = meanMar.get("avg_rad").getInfo() valMay = meanMay.get("avg_rad").getInfo() # 4. Validation if valMar is None or valMay is None: print("C3") count = ee.Image.cat([mar.first(), may.first()]).select("avg_rad")\ .reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), geom, 1000, maxPixels=1e9).get("avg_rad").getInfo() if count == 0: print("C2") print(f"Mar 2022: {valMar:.2f}, May 2022: {valMay:.2f}, Pixels: {int(count)}") print("A" if valMay < valMar else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
geom = ee.Geometry.Point([30.49, 50.51]).buffer(1000)   # Obolon ~1 km radius
mar = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG").filter(ee.Filter.date("2022-03-01", "2022-04-01"))
may = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG").filter(ee.Filter.date("2022-05-01", "2022-06-01"))

# 2. Check availability
if mar.size().getInfo() == 0 or may.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: Empty collection.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Extract mean radiance
meanMar = mar.first().select("avg_rad").reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
meanMay = may.first().select("avg_rad").reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)

valMar = meanMar.get("avg_rad").getInfo()
valMay = meanMay.get("avg_rad").getInfo()

# 4. Validation
if valMar is None or valMay is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
count = ee.Image.cat([mar.first(), may.first()]).select("avg_rad")\
          .reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.count(), geom, 1000, maxPixels=1e9).get("avg_rad").getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

print(f"Mar 2022: {valMar:.2f}, May 2022: {valMay:.2f}, Pixels: {int(count)}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if valMay < valMar else "<answer>B</answer>")
